pairs: Joshua was old and advanced in age,
and the Lord said to him:
and a very wide land remains,
which has not yet been divided by lot,
usque ad terminos Accaron contra aquilonem:
as far as the border of Ekron toward the north,
quæ in quinque regulos Philisthiim dividitur,
which is divided among the rulers of Philistia:
to the south are the Hivites,
as far as Aphek and the borders of the Amorite
also, the region of Lebanon toward the east,
omnium qui habitant in monte a Libano usque ad aquas Maserephoth,
all who live in the mountains from Lebanon, as far as the waters of Misrephoth,
Ego sum qui delebo eos a facie filiorum Israël.
I am the One who will wipe them out, before the face of the sons of Israel.
Veniat ergo in partem hæreditatis Israël,
Therefore, let their land become a part of the inheritance of Israel,
just as I have instructed you.
Et nunc divide terram in possessionem novem tribubus,
And now, divide the land as a possession to the nine tribes,
and to the one half tribe of Manasseh.”
cum qua Ruben et Gad possederunt terram,
With them, Reuben and Gad have possessed the land,
quam tradidit eis Moyses famulus Domini trans fluenta Jordanis,
which Moses, the servant of the Lord, delivered to them beyond the river Jordan,
quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon,
which is situated on the bank of the torrent Arnon
and in the midst of the valley,
and all the plains of Medeba,
et cunctas civitates Sehon regis Amorrhæi,
and all the cities of Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
even to the borders of the sons of Ammon;
as well as the borders of Geshur and Maacati,
the entire kingdom of Og in Bashan,
qui regnavit in Astaroth et Edrai,
who reigned at Ashtaroth and Edrei,
(he was among the last of the Rephaim).
And Moses struck and destroyed them.
And the sons of Israel were not willing to destroy Geshur and Maacati,
and so they have lived in the midst of Israel,
et habitaverunt in medio Israël usque in præsentem diem.
Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem:
But to the tribe of Levi, he did not give a possession.
sed sacrificia et victimæ Domini Dei Israël,
Instead, the sacrifices and victims of the Lord, the God of Israel,
just as he spoke to him.
Dedit ergo Moyses possessionem tribui filiorum Ruben juxta cognationes suas.
Therefore, Moses gave a possession to the tribe of the sons of Reuben, according to their families.
And their border was from Aroer,
quæ sita est in ripa torrentis Arnon,
which is situated on the bank of the torrent Arnon,
et in valle ejusdem torrentis media:
and in the midst of the valley of the same torrent,
with all the flatlands that lead to Medeba;
and Zereth-shahar on the mountain of the steep valley;
Bethpeor, and the descending slopes of Pisgah,
and all the cities of the plain,
and all the kingdoms of Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
quem percussit Moyses cum principibus Madian:
whom Moses struck down with the leaders of Midian: Evi,
et Rebe duces Sehon habitatores terræ.
the commanders of Sihon, inhabitants of the land.
Et Balaam filium Beor ariolum occiderunt filii Israël gladio cum ceteris interfectis.
And the sons of Israel killed Balaam, the son of Beor, the seer, with the sword, along with the others who were slain.
Factusque est terminus filiorum Ruben Jordanis fluvius.
And the river Jordan was made the border of the sons of Reuben;
Hæc est possessio Rubenitarum per cognationes suas urbium et viculorum.
this is the possession of the Reubenites, by their families, in cities and villages.
Deditque Moyses tribui Gad et filiis ejus per cognationes suas possessionem,
And Moses gave to the tribe of Gad and his sons, by their families, a possession,
of which this is the division:
and all the cities of Gilead,
et dimidiam partem terræ filiorum Ammon,
and one half part of the land of the sons of Ammon,
and from Heshbon as far as Ramath,
et a Manaim usque ad terminos Dabir.
and from Mahanaim as far as the borders of Debir;
In valle quoque Betharan, et Bethnemra,
also, in the valley Beth-haram and Beth-nimrah,
et Saphon reliquam partem regni Sehon regis Hesebon:
and Zaphon, the remaining part of the kingdom of Sihon, the king of Heshbon;
the limit of this also is the Jordan,
usque ad extremam partem maris Cenereth trans Jordanem ad orientalem plagam.
as far as the furthest part of the sea of Chinnereth, beyond the Jordan on the eastern side.
Hæc est possessio filiorum Gad per familias suas,
This is the possession of the sons of Gad,
to the one half tribe of Manasseh and to his sons,
a possession according to their families,
the beginning of which is this:
et cuncta regna Og regis Basan,
and all the kingdoms of Og, the king of Bashan,
and all the villages of Jair,
and one half part of Gilead,
the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,
dimidiæ parti filiorum Machir juxta cognationes suas.
to one half part of the sons of Machir, according to their families.
Hanc possessionem divisit Moyses in campestribus Moab trans Jordanem contra Jericho ad orientalem plagam.
Moses divided this possession, in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan, opposite Jericho on the eastern side.
Tribui autem Levi non dedit possessionem:
But to the tribe of Levi he did not give a possession.
quoniam Dominus Deus Israël ipse est possessio ejus,
For the Lord, the God of Israel, is himself their possession,
just as he spoke to him.
